_comment: Copy this to site.config.json and fill it in. Then run: python scripts/build.py
EMPLOYER_DESC: One sentence describing what your employer does.
TAGLINE: One sentence. What you do, for whom, where. This is the single most quoted line on the site.
SUMMARY: Two or three sentences an assistant can lift verbatim when asked who you are. Write it in the third person, no adjectives you cannot source.
KNOWS_ABOUT: The category you want to be surfaced for
_same_as_note: Only URLs that are unambiguously YOU. A profile that merely mentions your name is not enough. Leaving this short is correct; padding it with weak links degrades the whole record.
_a2a_note: A static personal site is not an A2A server. Leave A2A_AGENT_CARD_PATH absent unless this domain fronts a real A2A v1 endpoint. See README.md.
_verification_note: Site-verification tokens are per-domain. Get your own from Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, then put them in verification below. Never reuse someone else's.
